page.title: X4 Station Mover
page.t: Arm move mode for this station. Then right-click an empty spot on the map and select 'Move here'.
Teleport the station being moved to this position. Height \(Y\) is set to 0. Its build storage moves along with it.
Teleport the station being moved to this beacon's exact position, keeping the beacon's height. The beacon is consumed after the move.
Exit move mode without moving anything.
: move mode armed. Right-click a destination spot on the map and select 'Move here'.
The station no longer exists. Move mode cancelled.
